_about: SIGMA's weekly recording scripts. One section = one week = one recording (Script_01, Script_02 ...). Each line: [clip id, text, tone, date it is used (YYYY-MM-DD, optional)]. Ids are unique forever: q = Short question, L = long-form question, i = opener, r = reaction, s = sign-off, x = long-form line. `python3 engine/voice_bank.py scripts` writes the readable files into sigma-scripts/.

Script_01.title: Week 1 (29 Nov - 5 Dec)
lines: Sigma here. Question for the panel.
How many tigers live in India right now?
How many satellites has ISRO launched so far?
How much of India's power comes from the sun?
How many cups of tea does India drink a day?
How many foreign tourists visit India in a year?
How many Olympic medals has India ever won?
How many flights take off in India every day?
What does one single day in India look like, in numbers?
That's the sum of it. Sigma, signing off.
Same time tomorrow. Bring a question.
Grab a chai. This one's the long version.
That's the full story, in numbers. Sigma, out.
